main.header: Science at the service of the State and Society for tackling Climate Change.
main.content: The Climpact network seeks cooperation with the National Commission for Climate Change, with the Climate Change Impact Study Committee of the Bank of Greece but also with other relevant initiatives and actions. Climpact aims to be a pole of valid and multifaceted expertise and an advisory body of the State and Society.

network-associate.intro: The Climpact network is open to cooperation with all the scientific, research, and development organizations of the country dealing with the study and management of the effects of Climate Change. Your organization can officially become a collaborating member of the network and participate in its actions.
